profile.headline: Consultant Software Developer at Dollar General
profile.summary:
I have been doing professional software development since junior college. My very ☝first entrepreneurial projects while still in college were to develop medical applications and billing systems for doctors’ offices, health care agency & hospital.

I have worked in the following industries: ▼ 
Medical & Health Care, Banking & Finance, Manufacturing, Software, IT Consulting, Aerospace, Telecommunications, Gaming, Retail, and others. 


✔ I am a seasoned Senior Software Engineer with over 20+ years of experience with an excellent track record covering the full life cycle of software development on multiple platforms and environments. 

✔ I have excellent inter-personal & problem solving skills often executed under difficult circumstances and time requirement. Strong technical knowledge, skill acquisition, and presentation abilities. 

✔ I can work effectively with diverse personalities and individuals at all levels within an organization.


Development Languages & Tools: ▼
Visual Studio 2022, C# .NET, MVVM, MVC, Windows Phone, WPF, GitLab, Silverlight, WCF, XAML, Web API, LINQ, ORM, Entity Framework, SSRS, ADO.NET, ASP.NET, HTML, CSS, Telerik for MVC, Kendo UI, Angular, Javascript, C++/MFC, Visual Embedded C++, ATL, COM, SharePoint, TFS, SQL Server, Oracle.


Work Authorization: ▼
U.S. Citizen, Australian Citizen

positions.title: Consultant Software Developer
positions.description: Remote software development providing solutions for Dollar General Digital and Mobile systems for 12,000+ stores . Focused primarily in providing discount and pricing of store products.  Build and develop software to support Discount and Pricing Engine APIs for DG discounts, promos, coupons, orders, payments, user/device registrations, phone verification, SMS messaging, API security measures and identity management.  Interface with Dollar General partners and users and provide partner solution and integration to Dollar General Digital Systems. 	Development tools: Visual Studio 2017, C# .NET 4.5, Gigya SDK, Lexis Nexis SDK, WPF, LINQ, WebAPI,  GitLab, TortoiseGit, Fiddler, Oracle SQL Developer, Fireworks, SideSync, Agile/Scrum

positions.title: Sr. IT Systems Analyst /.NET Developer
positions.description:
Develop mobile applications for Store Systems deployed to 12,000+ DG stores.
Visual Studio 2015, C#  .NET 4.5, ADO.NET, ASP.NET MVC5, AJAX, JQuery, Unity Framework, Windows Phone 635/640, MVVM, XAML, Silver Light, XAP, LINQ, WebAPI,  Honeywell Scan Engine, Telerek UI for Windows Phone,  Telerek Kendo UI for ASP.NET MVC, MS SQLServer 2012, Team Foundation Server, Agile/Scrum.

positions.title: Sr. Software Developer
positions.description: Develop software focusing on automatic identification and data collection, radio frequency identification, and enterprise mobility. Develop end to end solutions in the areas of asset tracking, asset maintenance, warehousing, transportation, logistics execution, manufacturing execution, health care, federal government, energy, and supply chain.  Visual Studio 2013, C#  .NET 4.5, WPF, MVVM, WSDL, LINQ, Web Services, WebAPI, SoapUI, Entity Frame Work, AngularJS, JavaScript, MS SQLServer 2012, Team Foundation Server, Agile/Scrum.

positions.title: Sr. .NET Developer
positions.description: Implement and develop ISGM core business applications that manage and support over 2000 companies & contractors work force across a range of sectors, including design, construction, installation and maintenance, logistics and call centers across Australia.  Resolve day to day system requirements and code enhancements for Contractor Management System, Contractor Portal, WorkWize work flow, and IOrder material ordering systems and sub systems.  Visual Studio 2012, C#, .NET 4.0, 4.5, ASP.NET, LINQ, Entity Framework, SSRS, Model Binding, Test Automation, Telerik, SQL Server 2012, TeamCity, RedMine, SubVersion.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: Develop commercial software for 800 regional banks in the US.  Checking, Deposits, Risk & Fraud Verification, Check ordering, and Customer account maintenance.  Visual Studio 2010, C#  .NET 4.0, WPF, WCF, XAML, LINQ, Web Services, MVVM, Entity Frame Work, Prism Design Pattern, Parallel Multi-threading, MS SQLServer 2008, SharePoint, Agile/Scrum.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Implement commercial applications and infrastructure of core middleware code for Seven-Eleven stores in the US and Canada fuel pump systems and POS (Point Of Sale) systems.  
Interface with both hardware and software sub systems that makes up the NEC Retail Solution System.  Write and implement functional and technical designs on new features affecting middleware and POS systems.  Visual Studio 2008/C++ 6.0, Rogue Wave/STL, Sockets, Multi-threading, COM, Windows Services, MS SQLServer 2000, SharePoint.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for the design and implementation of EndPoint Exchange enhancements and features.
Assigned as a software developer for EndPoint Exchange commercial software that enables U.S. banks and other financial institutions process checks transactions electronically to and from Bank of First Deposits and Federal Reserve Bank end points.  Developed critical delivery services (DeliveryAdjustment, DeliveryFED, DeliveryMI, DeliveryViewPointe, DeliverySVPCo), WebSphereMQ and ConnectDirect intefaces.  Add feature enhancements to current software DepositShield & EndPointServer.  Conversion of unmanaged code to managed code.  Web Development.  Visual Studio 2008, C++, C#, ASP.NET, MVC2, Infragistics, WPF, WCF, XAML, .NET 3.5, CLI/CLR, MSTEST/TDD, MFC, Multi-threading, COM, XML, Team Foundation Server 2008/2010, MSMQ, MS SQL Server, VMWare.  Agile/Scrum.

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.description: Assigned in the Legacy Team to design and implement Avaya Solution Designer (ASD) and Price List Administration Tool (PLAT) applications for Direct, Tier1, & Tier2 Customers.  Extract business requirements from various system business owners.  Analyze, write, and implement system functional design from detailed business requirements.  Retooling and development of Avaya’s highly critical front line pricing modules that delivers end to end solutions for hardware, software, and services to various business partners and distributors world-wide.  Position requires weekly travel to and from Denver and Basking Ridge, NJ.  Involved in planning and decision making in critical aspects of software requirements and lock down sessions.  Visual Studio 2008/C++, MFC, Multi-threading, COM, Web logic, SAP, BAPI, SharePoint.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: Develop commercial software. Responsible for design and implementation of new product suite SystemCare. Integration of SystemSuite7 components.  Develop new feature for SystemSuite8 LinkScanner. Extensive UI development using proprietary interface.  Provide protection for malicious sites and exploits using Google, Yahoo, and MSN search engines.  Write and maintain commercial web applications for product and e-commerce systems.  Implement web services to support all client requirements and new features, localize languages and build new product for US, UK, FRA, and DEU markets.  Manage server side software and support desktop clients, web clients, and mobile client development requirements.  Visual Studio 2005,2008/.NET2003, MFC, C#, ASP.NET, ADO.NET, XML, JavaScript, ASP, Win32, Multi-threading, Custom User Interface API, COM, SearchShield and LinkScanner API, Pluggins, SQL Server 2005.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: Redesign and architecture of critical financial applications and processes.  Conversion of high volume single threaded applications into multi-threaded applications and processes.  Rewrite credit card premium fees processing, credit card enrollment processing, and customer gift card processing.   XML data communication to and from SQL Server and components via canonical systems.  Write design documents and participate in client business services planning.  Visual Studio C++/MFC, Multi-threading, COM, MTS, XML, SQL Server 2005.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: Develop back end and front end applications with Google Earth client software.  Develop Translator software that downloads and decompress satellite imagery from vendor’s FTP sites.  Parse satellite image components (shape, polygons, boundaries, etc) and update production image portals.  Write network link module that displays satellite images on Google Earth based on bounding earth’s latitude and longitude coordinates.  Develop Host Control Interface software that test Palm’s Treo cell phones using dynamic hardware test parameters.  Develop conversion tool that parses device source header files into XML for host definition.  Send, receive, and translate messages into human readable messages via serial communication ports. Visual Studio 2005, KML, ArcGIS, PHP, MySQL , Serial interface, ActiveX.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: Develop applications for the Gaming Industry using Linux development tools and participate in the Nevada Gaming Board.  Extensive slot machine dynamic touch screen user interfaces development, socket communications to NAM server components, communications to video server components.  Establish communications to Java Servers using XML subsystems to drive display drivers for the slot machine user interface.   Write applications for Pocket PC using infrared communications and Microsoft Embedded systems.  Kylex, Anjuta, GTKMM++, Visual C++, Embedded Visual C++, Symbol Pocket PC, Linux Red Hat, TCP/IP, Multi-threading, POSIX threads, OOD-Use Case, Nevada Gaming Card.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: Assigned as an Interface Developer to design and implement Mpower's MaGiC critical client-server sub  systems.  Successfully implemented the following software:  DMS-500 Server, the core-server application that services telecommunication transactions requests against Nortel's DMS-500 class 5 telephone switching equipment.  Network Console, a client-server application that monitors all of MaGiC's servers and sub systems anywhere on the network and provides visibility and alert capability on all critical sub systems.  	DMS-500 TroubleShooter, a client application to the DMS-500 Server used by hundreds of users nationwide that allows users to diagnose revenue lines by providing connection status(e.g. voltage AC/DC, Tip To Ring, and Ring indicators, etc) and NPA/NXX routing capabilities through out Mpower's national market locations.  DMS-500 Translator, a client application to the DMS-500  server that provides automatic processing of orders and provisioning of revenue lines.  All software are in production state and are deployed throughout Mpower’s national locations.  Nortel Telecommunications software & hardware, DMS 500 Switch, Visual C++ 6.0/MFC, ATL COM, CORBA Orbix, Multi-threading, TCP/IP, Sockets, RS232, Serial Communication, Windows NT 4.0, OOD-Use Case, SQL Server 7.0.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Major: Computer Science, Minor: Management Information Systems
